steps.step: F0.antiperiodic critical ring: unique half-filled vacuum (128 occupied, no zero mode)
F1.raw station clock R_station (x) I_64 = twisted quarter translation c_j -> c_{j+64} (sign on wrap)
F2.R Omega = Omega: R C R^T = C (vacuum invariant); also homogeneous under the one-site twisted shift
F3.R A(I) R^-1 = A(I + N/4) for all tested arcs (signed permutation of local modes)
F4.R^4 = -I (antiperiodic NS sign = (-1)^F on the fermions); projectively order 4
F5.lattice vacuum = Moebius-covariant NS kernel 1/(N sin(pi d/N)) on odd separations (rel. dev.)
F6.marks on the seam circle => lambda real; tetrahedral (j=0) lambda is non-real, so an order-3 geometric clock is impossible
steps.detail: lambda_tet = 1/2 - sqrt(3)*I/2; an order-3 circle rotation has orbits of size 3, 4 marks cannot form them

steps.step: F7.equal stations (4 x 64): station boundaries at angles k pi/2, cross-ratio 2 (lambda = -1 orbit, square)
F7b.negative control: unequal stations (60,68,64,64) give a non-harmonic real cross-ratio: no order-4 Moebius covariance
